description: This file defines the `BugsViewDetail` class, which extends `ViewDetail`, and manages the display logic for a bug detail view in the SuiteCRM application, including retrieval of admin settings to enable portal features.

classes.name: BugsViewDetail
classes.description: A view class for displaying the details of a bug record, with custom logic to enable portal features based on admin settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the display method to check if portal is enabled in admin settings and assigns a template variable accordingly, then calls the parent display method.
